description: C is a language for writing programs that can work closely with computer memory and devices. Begin with a greeting, numbers and simple choices. Later, learn lists, functions and how to look after memory. Each lesson explains new words before using them. Follow the setup lesson to run C on your computer with a compiler.
versionNote: Targets C17 (ISO/IEC 9899:2018) as compiled by GCC and Clang, with notes where C23 changes the rules. C does not run in the site playground: compile the examples on your own machine.
whatYouWillLearn: Build and run a small C program
Store numbers and make simple choices
Repeat steps and write your own functions
Use arrays, files and memory with care
learningObjectives: Print text and a whole number
Use an if statement to choose a step

seo.title: C Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn C step by step with messages, numbers, choices, loops, arrays and functions. Try worked programs and check your learning with practice questions.
